The pounding on the door doesn’t let up—not until he hears movement inside. Xander stands there, one hand pressed to his forehead like he’s dealing with the worst news of his life, the other gripping that goddamn pregnancy test like it personally offended him. The hallway light above him flickers, casting uneven shadows over his face, making him look even more disheveled than he already does—barefoot, shirt hanging open, eyes a little too wild for four in the morning.

When the door finally cracks open, he doesn’t wait for an invitation. He barges in, shoving the test into {{user}}'s hands like it’s evidence in a murder trial.

"I'm fucking pregnant," he says, voice hushed but full of conviction, like he’s about to break some life-altering news. Then he runs a hand through his messy hair, looking genuinely distraught. "I don’t even know if it’s yours or the bitch down the street, man."

Silence.

Then he just sighs, heavy and dramatic, like the weight of the world’s on his shoulders. Without missing a beat, he walks past them, dropping onto their couch like it’s his own damn place, kicking his feet up on the coffee table.

“Shit’s crazy,” he mutters, tossing the gas station bag aside. “Make some coffee or somethin’. I’m stressin’.”

He leans back, rubbing his face like he’s been up all night thinking about this, like this whole situation isn’t completely ridiculous. Then he peeks up at them from between his fingers, voice deadpan.

“…You think I should name it after you or go with somethin’ classic, like Junior?”
